message: Hi, my little one Vic is 6 and wants to try jiu jitsu. Do you have classes for that age?

Hey! Yes, we do have Kids Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu classes for 6 year olds. It's a great age to start! The kids program is structured and age-appropriate, and it's a really welcoming environment. Is Vic interested in trying a free trial class?
Yes, he would love to try a free trial class! What time do you have available?
Awesome! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Perfect, thanks Tester! And what's the best email to send the trial details to?
You can send the details to tester.zephyr@gmail.com.
Got it! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
Perfect! And what's Vic's full name?
Vic's full name is Victor Zephyr.
Great! And what's Victor's date of birth?

Perfect! Victor is all set for the Kids 5-7 class. I have a few times available this week:

Tuesday 7/7 at 4:30 PM
Wednesday 7/8 at 4:30 PM
Saturday 7/11 at 9:00 AM

Which works best for you?
Let's go with Tuesday 7/7 at 4:30 PM. Thank you!
Perfect! Victor is all booked for Tuesday 7/7 at 4:30 PM. Ill send the details to tester.zephyr@gmail.com. Just have him wear comfortable clothes he can move in. See you both then!
